scope:
Execute the preregistered fresh B64/B128 domains after all numerical gates.
Retain failures as separate outcomes; inference is performed by the joint-family
analysis. Explicit midpoint values are diagnostics, never exact probabilities.

quality_family.scope: Fixed quality family before fresh guarded-click samples. PNR is a complete deterministic replay of the frozen32768-record86 dataset, not additional observations. Groups and the PNR pilot split remain unchanged; its per-event alpha is conservatively reduced for the new combined family.
quality_family.failure_policy: Any incomplete spectrum makes the full record a separate target-zero failure symbol. Keep every row; no deletion or refill.
quality_family.gate: Fresh direct sampling starts only after scalar enclosure checks, independent small probabilities and complete frozen86 B64 replay. B128 additionally requires a frozen86 B128 oracle pilot with matched uniforms. Failure of a gate is retained and corrected in a new version, never hidden.
quality_family.limits: Nominal concentration assumes iid. Numerical references and projected covariance arithmetic are not interval-certified Gaussian states. Local TV upper bounds do not cover the full1152-bit law. Enclosure midpoints are not exact conditional probabilities.
